visualization.name: WARC Explorer
visualization.description: Explore archived web records, headers, and payloads
visualization.help:
# What is the WARC Explorer?
The WARC Explorer lets you browse web archives stored in the WARC format directly in your browser. A WARC file holds the records captured while crawling websites: requests, responses, metadata and the archived page content.
After selecting a gzip-compressed WARC dataset, the archive is indexed in your browser and its records are listed for inspection. Archive data stays in your browser.
## Key Features
- **Record Filters**: Filter records by type and search by URI or record ID. - **Header Viewers**: Inspect WARC and HTTP headers of each record. - **Payload Display**: View text or binary payloads, with decoded previews of up to 16 MiB. - **Isolated HTML Previews**: HTML previews are static, with scripts and live resource requests blocked.
Selected records are fetched with HTTP byte ranges when available. Files compressed as a single gzip member are read sequentially, which can be slower.
This tool inspects individual archive records, making it useful for web archivists and researchers working with crawled web content.
To learn more, visit: - [WARC Explorer by the National Library of Norway](https://github.com/NationalLibraryOfNorway/webdata-warc-explorer) - [WARC format specification](https://iipc.github.io/warc-specifications/)
